key_insight: OracleImitator learns which features to acquire by distilling an explicit oracle that ranks candidates by their effect on prediction error.
engineering_relevance: Instance-specific feature acquisition can reduce measurement cost, latency, or privacy burden while preserving predictive accuracy.
method: Construct a training-time oracle using labels and unobserved feature values.
Distill the oracle’s feature rankings into a deployable policy through soft-target imitation.
Measure how much oracle ranking information is recoverable from deployment-visible inputs.
evidence_signal: Across multimodal medical diagnosis and AFABench evaluations, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across budgets and recovers 90% of attainable accuracy gain at under one-quarter of acquisition cost.
watch_item: Training requires labels and unobserved feature values, while deployment-visible information may not fully support the oracle’s rankings.
paper_title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
